# Peptides, Practiced.

> A peptide therapy reference library for licensed prescribers: peptide selection, dosing, cycling and monitoring for complex patients. 11 teaching volumes, 5 condition protocols, reference tools and a peptide dose calculator. Written by Monika Rodriguez, MSN, ARNP, FNP-C, certified in peptide therapy through A4M (I and Advanced II). Part of Practiced (practiced.health).

## What it is
- Teaching volumes: Mitochondrial; Thymic & Immune; Anti-inflammatory & Mucosal (includes BPC-157); Antimicrobial; GH Axis; GLP & Metabolic; Tissue Repair; Cognitive, Neuro & HPG; Gut; Klotho & Longevity Protein; Skin & Hair
- Each peptide entry: what it is, mechanism of action, clinical indications, dosing rationale and timing, evidence base, contraindications, drug interactions, baseline labs and monitoring, side effects, stacking and synergy, clinical pearls; most open with a vial, dose, route and cycle table
- Condition protocols: concussion and head injury; systemic anti-aging and longevity; mold, mycotoxin and environmental illness; chronic viral reactivation; gut rebuild
- Reference tools: regenerative medicine primer, low-dose GLP-1 for inflammation, dose and indication reference, regulatory/sourcing/prescribing landscape, peptide consent template, monitoring labs, biological age testing, references and citations
- Dose calculator: vial strength, bacteriostatic water and target dose to units on a U-100 insulin syringe
- Audience: licensed prescribers (physicians, NPs, PAs). Clinical education, not medical advice for patients.

## Access and price
- Preview (no account): Volume 1 (Mitochondrial) and the dose calculator: https://peptides.practiced.health/
- Full library: $1,497 one-time, includes one year of updates
- Sign-in: purchase email, then an emailed 6-digit code
- Separate add-on: Compliance-Ready Peptide Program (state-specific intake, consent and documentation forms)
- Support: support@practiced.health
